mission.title: Our Mission
content: DripLove is more than just a dating app – we're a global community dedicated to helping people find authentic connections and meaningful relationships. Our mission is to create a safe, inclusive, and vibrant platform where love knows no boundaries.
Whether you're looking for your soulmate, lifelong partner, or new friendships, DripLove provides the tools and community to help you discover genuine connections that matter.

different.title: What Makes Us Different
different.intro: DripLove stands out in the crowded dating app landscape through our commitment to:
points: Authentic connections based on shared values and interests
A diverse, global community that celebrates all backgrounds
Advanced matching algorithms that prioritize compatibility

community.title: Global Community
content: From New York to Nairobi, London to Lagos, Tokyo to Toronto – DripLove connects hearts across continents. Our platform brings together vibrant souls from all walks of life, creating a truly global dating experience.
Love doesn't recognize borders, and neither do we. Whether you're seeking local connections or international romance, DripLove makes it possible.

authenticity.title: Authenticity
authenticity.description: We encourage genuine connections and real conversations.

inclusivity.title: Inclusivity
inclusivity.description: Everyone is welcome regardless of background, identity, or beliefs.

safety.title: Safety
safety.description: Your security and privacy are our top priorities.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.description: We continuously improve to provide the best dating experience.

journey.title: Our Journey
journey.content: Founded in 2024, DripLove was born from a simple belief: everyone deserves to find love. Our team is passionate about creating technology that brings people together, not drives them apart.

contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.content: We love hearing from our community! Whether you have questions, feedback, or just want to say hi, we're here for you.
contact.social: Follow us on social media to stay updated with the latest features and success stories.

company.title: About The ScREAte Ltd
content: DripLove is proudly created by The ScREAte Ltd, a technology company dedicated to building innovative digital experiences that bring people together. We specialize in creating platforms that foster genuine human connections.
Our team combines technical expertise with a deep understanding of human relationships to create products that make a meaningful difference in people's lives.

safety.title: Safety & Security
safety.intro: Your safety is paramount to us. DripLove implements comprehensive security measures including:

adinkraMeanings.Aya: The fern. Symbol of endurance and resourcefulness.
adinkraMeanings.Nkyinkyim: Twisting. Symbol of initiative, dynamism, and versatility.
adinkraMeanings.Eban: Fence. Symbol of love, safety, and security.
adinkraMeanings.Fihankra: House/compound. Symbol of security and safety.
adinkraMeanings.Gye Nyame: Except for God. Symbol of the supremacy of God.
adinkraMeanings.Sankofa: Go back and get it. Symbol of learning from the past.
adinkraMeanings.Duafe: Wooden comb. Symbol of beauty, cleanliness, feminine qualities.
adinkraMeanings.Fawohodie: Independence. Symbol of freedom, emancipation, independence.
adinkraMeanings.Akoma: The heart. Symbol of patience and tolerance.
adinkraMeanings.Akoben: War horn. Symbol of vigilance and wariness.
adinkraMeanings.Adinkrahene: Chief of the adinkra symbols. Symbol of greatness, charisma, and leadership.
adinkraMeanings.Bese Saka: Sack of cola nuts. Symbol of affluence, power, abundance, unity.
adinkraMeanings.Dame-Dame: Checkerboard. Symbol of intelligence and ingenuity.
adinkraMeanings.Dwennimmen: Ram's horns. Symbol of humility together with strength.
adinkraMeanings.Nyame Dua: Tree of God. Symbol of God's presence and protection.
adinkraMeanings.Boa Me Na Me Mmoa Wo: Help me and let me help you. Symbol of cooperation and interdependence.
